name: Marcus T.
text: Great article! I just repainted my guest bedroom in Benjamin Moore's 'Cloud White' and the photos for my listing look so much brighter. The neutral tones really do make a difference when buyers are scrolling through online.

name: Jennifer K.
text: Question: what about accent walls? I'm thinking of doing a deep blue feature wall in my living room but now I'm worried it'll look too dark in photos. Should I skip the accent entirely?

name: Robert L.
text: I disagree with avoiding warm whites. We painted our kitchen in a soft cream and it photographs beautifully, especially with natural morning light. It's all about your lighting situation.

name: Sarah M.
text: This is exactly what I needed! Tried a sage green in my bedroom last year and every photo came out looking muddy. Switching to a lighter palette next month.

name: David C.
text: Has anyone tried the Sherwin Williams colors mentioned here? I'm about to list my condo and want to touch up a few walls before staging.
